findings.diagnosis: The prompt underrates the damage of cutting before a phrase's obligatory complement (objects of prepositions, measurement units, or a closing parenthesis), so it often places cuts that leave an incomplete prepositional/measurement expression and yield high contradiction when the remainder arrives.
findings.evidence: ['en_us_44','en_us_360','en_us_733','en_us_738','en_us_1384','en_us_140','en_us_101','en_us_1253'] share the same failure: each source was split so that a preposition, an opening parenthesis, or a numeral was left without its object/unit/closing parenthesis immediately following, and those splits produced the high-contradiction, low-H_set outcomes seen in the targets.
findings.type_predicate: The sentence contains a preposition or an opening parenthesis, or a numeral/quantity, whose syntactic complement (object noun, measurement unit, or the closing parenthesis) does not appear immediately next in the linear string.

edit.text: Do not cut between a preposition, an opening parenthesis, or a numeral and the word or phrase that completes its object or unit; wait until that complement or the closing parenthesis appears.
